 class Author(Thing):
     """Class to represent /type/author objects in OL."""
 
+    def merge_remote_ids(self, incoming_ids: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[dict[str, str], int]:
+        """Return merged identifiers and the number of identical existing values.
+
+        The author is left untouched so callers can decide when to save the merge.
+        """
+        merged = dict(self.get('remote_ids') or {})
+        matches = 0
+        for kind, value in incoming_ids.items():
+            if kind in merged and merged[kind] != value:
+                raise AuthorRemoteIdConflictError(
+                    f"Conflicting {kind} remote ID for author {self.key}: "
+                    f"{merged[kind]!r} != {value!r}"
+                )
+            if kind in merged:
+                matches += 1
+            merged[kind] = value
+        return merged, matches
+

 class Author(Thing):
     """Class to represent /type/author objects in OL."""
 
+    def merge_remote_ids(self, incoming_ids: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[dict[str, str], int]:
+        """Return merged identifiers and the number of identical existing values.
+
+        The author is left untouched so callers can decide when to save the merge.
+        """
+        merged = dict(self.get('remote_ids') or {})
+        matches = 0
+        for kind, value in incoming_ids.items():
+            if kind in merged and merged[kind] != value:
+                raise AuthorRemoteIdConflictError(
+                    f"Conflicting {kind} remote ID for author {self.key}: "
+                    f"{merged[kind]!r} != {value!r}"
+                )
+            if kind in merged:
+                matches += 1
+            merged[kind] = value
+        return merged, matches
